tap_caption.text: Tap to set. Each tap goes to the server.

drag_caption.text: Drag and release. The value shows at once and reaches the server on release.

tap_caption.text: Tap a stop. The server sends back the chosen word.

drag_caption.text: Drag: the word changes on screen at once and reaches the server on release.

tap_caption.text: Tap the bar. The server moves the nearer handle.

drag_caption.text: Drag low and high and release. The server sorts them if they cross.

intro.text: Tap a spot in the square. Each cell is one value pair, 10 by 10.

axis_note.text: Top left is X 5, Y 5. Values are cell centers.
